independent_code_review: Each auxiliary report covers either 11 regular fixed workloads or the million-mechanism workload; no individual report claims the full corpus.
The four registered packet/role combinations cover both partitions for packet and strongest-direct routes.
The helper binds the immutable source, build manifest, runner, native library, accepted validator, real scheduler context, requested candidate mode and actual dispatch metadata.
It validates fixed-oracle output and all five VJPs, repeated VJP, input/result wire digests and preserves failed-case wires.
The packet implementation's stable backend is explicitly reflected in the report when record-derived fan-in rules select it.
